words.en: My coat and my umbrella please.
words.zh: 请把我的大衣和伞拿给我。
这是我（寄存东西）的牌子。

words.en: Here's your umbrella and your coat.

words.zh: 这位是索菲娅.杜邦小姐。

words.en: Nice to see you too Steven.
words.zh: 我见到你也很高兴，史蒂文。
你的新连衣裙是什么颜色的？
你们的朋友也是丹麦人吗？
你们的朋友也是来旅游的吗？

words.en: Come and meet our employees Mr. Richards.
words.zh: 来见见我们的雇员，理查兹先生。

words.en: This is Nicola Grey and this is Claire Taylor.
words.zh: 这位是尼克拉.格雷，这位是克莱尔.泰勒。

words.en: This is Michael Baker and this is Jeremy Short.
words.zh: 这位是迈克尔.贝克，这位是杰里米.肖特。
是我们办公室的勤杂人员。

words.en: Give me a book please, Jane.
Give me some glasses please, Jane.
words.zh: 请拿给我几只玻璃杯，简。
史密斯夫人的厨房很小。

words.en: There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.
There is an electric cooker in the kitchen.
There is a table in the middle of the room.
There is a bottle on the table.
There is a cup on the table, too.
Mrs. Smith's living room is large.
words.zh: 史密斯夫人的客厅很大。

words.en: There is a television in the room.
The television is near the window.
There are some magazines on the television.
words.zh: 电视机上放着几本杂志。

words.en: There is a table in the room.
There are some newspapers on the table.
There are some armchairs in the room.
The armchairs are near the table.
There is a stereo in the room.
words.zh: 客厅里有台立体声音响。

words.en: The stereo is near the door.
There are some books on the stereo.
There are some pictures in the room.
The pictures are on the wall.
What must I do, Mrs. Jones?
words.zh: 我应该做些什么呢，琼斯夫人？

words.en: Open the window and air the room.
words.zh: 打开窗子，给房间通通风。

words.en: Then put these clothes in the wardrobe.
words.zh: 然后把这些衣服放进衣橱里去。

words.en: Is Tim in the garden, too?
The dog's in the garden, too.
It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky, but the sun is shining.
words.zh: 天空中飘着几朵云，但阳光灿烂。

words.en: Mr. Jones is with his family.
words.zh: 琼斯先生同他的家人在一起。

words.en: They are walking over the bridge.
There are some boats on the river.
Mr. Jones and his wife are looking at them.
words.zh: 琼斯先生和他的妻子正在看这些船。

words.en: Sally is looking at a big ship.
words.zh: 莎莉正在观看一艘大船。

words.en: The ship is going under the bridge.
Tim is looking at an aeroplane.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.
This is a photograph of our village.
words.zh: 这是我们村庄的一张照片。

words.en: Our village is in a valley.
words.zh: 我们的村庄坐落在一个山谷之中。

words.en: The village is on a river.
Here is another photograph of the village.
words.zh: 这是我们村庄的另一张照片。

words.en: My wife and I are walking along the banks of the river.
There is a boy in the water.
He is swimming across the river.
The park is on the right.
Some children are coming out of the building.
words.zh: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。

words.en: Some of them are going into the park.
words.zh: 他们中有几个正走进公园。

words.en: Give me that hammer please, Dan.
words.zh: 请把那把锤子拿给我，丹。

words.en: What are you going to do now, George?
words.zh: 你现在打算干什么，乔治？

words.en: What colour are you going to paint it?
words.zh: 你打算把它漆成什么颜色？

words.en: I'm going to paint it pink.

words.zh: 这个书架不是为我做的。
是为我的女儿苏珊做的。
粉红色是她最喜欢的颜色。

words.en: What are you going to do with that vase, Penny?
words.zh: 彭妮，你打算如何处理那只花瓶？

words.en: I'm going to put it on this table, Sam.
words.zh: 我打算把它放在这张桌子上，萨姆。

words.en: What are you going to do with it?
I'm going to put it here, in front of the window.
words.zh: 我准备把它放在这儿，放在窗前。

words.en: Put it here, on this shelf.
A quarter of a pound of tea.
Is that tin of tobacco for me?
Well, it's certainly not for me!
Can you make the tea, Sam?
Yes, of course I can, Penny.
Is there any water in this kettle?
It's over there, behind the teapot.
I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.
words.zh: 茶壶我看见了，但茶叶没看到。

words.en: Ah yes, I can see it now.
There are some in the cupboard.
Can you come here a minute please, Bob?
Can she type this letter for me?
words.zh: 她能为我打一下这封信吗？

words.en: Can you type this letter for the boss please, Pamela?
words.zh: 请你把这封信给老板打一下可以吗，帕梅拉？
好的，请来一杯，克里斯廷。

words.en: I don't like milk in my coffee.
words.zh: 我不喜欢咖啡中放牛奶。

words.en: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?
words.zh: 您今天要买点肉吗，伯德夫人？

words.en: Do you want beef or lamb?
words.zh: 您要牛肉还是要羔羊肉？

words.en: I like lamb, but my husband doesn't.
words.zh: 我喜欢羔羊肉，可我丈夫不喜欢。

words.en: And a pound of mince, too.
Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird?
words.zh: 您要买只鸡吗，伯德夫人？

words.en: My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.
words.zh: 我丈夫喜欢牛排，但他不喜欢鸡。

words.en: To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird, I don't like chicken either!
words.zh: 说老实话，伯德夫人，我也不喜欢鸡。

words.en: What's the climate like in your country?
words.zh: 你们的国家的气候是怎么样？

words.en: What's the weather like in spring?
It's always warm in April and May, but it rains sometimes.
words.zh: 4月和5月的天气总暖洋洋的，但有时下雨。

words.en: It's always hot in June, July and August.
words.zh: 6月、7月和8月的天气总是炎热的。

words.en: Is it cold or warm in autumn?
words.zh: 秋季的天气是冷还是暖呢？

words.en: It's always warm in September and October.
It's often cold in November and it rains sometimes.
words.zh: 11月常常就冷了，而且有时下雨。

words.en: Is it very cold in winter?
It's often cold in December, January and February.
What's the climate like in your country?
words.zh: 你们国家的气候怎么样？

words.en: It's mild, but it's not always pleasant.
words.zh: 气候温和，但也不总是宜人的。

words.en: The weather's often cold in the North and windy in the East.
words.zh: 北部的天气常常寒冷，东部则常常刮风。

words.en: It's often wet in the West and sometimes warm in the South.
words.zh: 西部常下雨，南部有时则很暖和。

words.en: Which seasons do you like best?
The days are long and the nights are short.
The sun rises early and sets late.
I don't like autumn and winter.
The days are short and the nights are long.
The sun rises late and sets early.
Our climate is not very good, but it's certainly interesting.
words.zh: 虽然我们国家的气候并不很好，但又确实很有意思。

words.en: It's our favourite subject of conversation.
words.zh: 天气是我们最喜欢谈论的话题。

words.en: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
words.zh: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。

words.en: In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
words.zh: 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。

words.en: Their father takes them to school every day.
words.zh: 父亲每天送孩子们去上学。

words.en: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
words.zh: 索耶夫人每天呆在家里。

words.en: She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
words.zh: 下午，她总是会见她的朋友。

words.en: In the evening, the children come home from school.
Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
At night, the children always do their homework.
words.zh: 晚上，孩子们总是做作业。

words.en: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
words.zh: 索耶先生总是读报纸，但有时和他的妻子一起看电视。

words.en: The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.
words.zh: 孩子们每天都乘小汽车去上学，而今天，他们正步行上学。

words.en: Mrs. Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning, but this morning, she is going to the shops.
words.zh: 上午，索耶夫人通常是呆在家里的，但今天上午，她正去商店买东西。

words.en: In the afternoon, Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room.
words.zh: 下午，索耶夫人通常是在客厅里喝茶。

words.en: But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
words.zh: 但今天下午，她正在花园里喝茶。

words.en: In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
words.zh: 晚上，孩子们通常是做作业，而今天晚上，他们没做企业。

words.en: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
words.zh: 此刻，他们正在花园里玩。

words.en: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night.
words.zh: 索耶先生通常是在晚上看报。

words.en: But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.
At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.
words.zh: 此刻，他正在看一本有趣的书。

words.en: Do you want the large size or the small size?
words.zh: 您要大号的还是小号的？

words.en: Do you have any writing paper?
I don't have any small pads.
And I want a large box of chalk, too.
Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?
words.zh: 你还得医生的电话号码吗？

words.en: What's the matter with him, doctor?
He has a bad cold, Mr. Williams, so he must stay in bed for a week.
words.zh: 他得了重感冒，威廉斯先生，因此他必须卧床一周。
对吉米来说，这可是个好消息。

words.en: Can I see him please, Mrs. Williams?
words.zh: 我可以看看他吗，威廉斯夫人？

words.en: You are better now, but you mustn't get up yet.
words.zh: 你现在好些了，但你还不应该起床。

words.en: You must stay in bed for another two days.
The boy mustn't go to school yet, Mrs. Williams.
words.zh: 这孩子还不能去上学，威廉斯夫人。

words.en: And he mustn't eat rich food.
words.zh: 而且不能吃油腻的食物。

words.en: Does he have a temperature, doctor?
He must remain in bed for another two days.
He can get up for about two hours each day, but you must keep the room warm.
words.zh: 他每天可以起来两个小时，但您必须保持房间温暖。
威廉斯先生今晚去哪儿了？

words.en: He has a bad cold, too!
What are you going to do this evening, Jill?
words.zh: 今晚你打算干什么，吉尔？

words.en: I'm going to meet some friends, Dad.
words.zh: 我打算去看几个朋友，爸爸。

words.en: You must be home at half past ten.
I can't get home so early, Dad!
words.zh: 这么早我到不了家，爸爸！

words.en: Can I have the key to the front door, please?
words.zh: 我能带上前门的钥匙吗？

words.en: But you mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.
words.zh: 但你不能超过11点1刻回家。
我们总是玩得很开心的，妈妈。

words.en: Were you at the butcher's, too?
Was he absent from school last week?
He was absent on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
words.zh: 他星期一、星期二、星期三和星期四没去上学。

words.en: We're going to spend three days in the country!
words.zh: 我们打算到乡下去住三天！

words.en: We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country!
words.zh: 星期五、星期六和星期日在乡下过！

words.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
words.zh: 在我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。

words.en: In 1995, there was a very big race.
There were hundreds of people there.
words.zh: 许许多多人都去了赛场。

words.en: My wife and I were at the race.
Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
words.zh: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也去了。

words.en: You can see us in the crowd.
words.zh: 你可以在人群中看到我们。

words.en: We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
words.zh: 有英国、法国、德国、意大利和日本的汽车。
比赛的结尾是激动人心的。
获胜者是比利.斯图尔特。

words.en: He was in car number fifteen.
Five other cars were just behind him.
words.zh: 其他5辆汽车跟在他后面。

words.en: On the way home, my wife said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!
words.zh: 在回家的途中，我妻子对我说：“别开得这样快！”
你可不是比利.斯图尔特！
波淋，朗.马顿是怎样一个人？

words.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday and three times the day before yesterday.
words.zh: 他昨天给我打了4次电话前天打了3次。

words.en: He telephoned the office yesterday morning and yesterday afternoon.
words.zh: 他昨天上午和下午把电话打到了我的办公室。

words.en: What did your boss say to him?
words.zh: 你老板是怎么对他说的？

words.en: She can't speak to you now!'
Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening.
words.zh: 后来，我昨晚6点钟回到家里。

words.en: But I didn't answer the phone!
Did he telephone again last night?
words.zh: 他昨夜里又打电话了吗？

words.en: What did you say to him?
Please don't telephone my daughter again!'
words.zh: 请不要再给我女儿打电话了！

courses.title: Lesson 73 · The Way to King Street

words.en: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
words.zh: 上星期米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。

words.en: She does not know London very well, and she lost her way.
words.zh: 她对伦敦不很熟悉，因此迷了路。

words.en: Suddenly, she saw a man near a bus stop.
words.zh: 突然，她在公共汽车站附近看到一个男人。

words.en: 'I can ask him the way,' she said to herself.
'Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?'
words.zh: “您能告诉我到国王街怎么走吗？”

words.en: Then he put his hand into his pocket, and took out a phrasebook.
words.zh: 然后他把手伸进了衣袋，掏出了一本常用语手册。

words.en: He opened the book and found a phrase.
words.zh: 他翻开书找到了一条短语。

words.en: Do you have any shoes like these?
words.zh: 像这样的鞋子你们有吗？

words.en: But my sister bought this pair last month.
words.zh: 但是，我姐姐上个月买到了这样的一双。

words.en: No, she bought them in the U. S. We had some shoes like those a month ago, but we don't have any now.
words.zh: 不。她是在美国买的。一个月前我们有这要的鞋。但是现在没有了。

words.en: Can you get a pair for me, please?
They were in fashion last year and the year before last.
words.zh: 这鞋在去年和前年时兴。

words.en: But they're not in fashion this year.
These shoes are in fashion now.
words.zh: 现在流行的是这种鞋子。
这种鞋子看上去很不舒适。

words.en: But women always wear uncomfortable shoes!
words.zh: 可是女人们总是穿不舒适的鞋子！

words.en: I want to see the dentist, please.
Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
words.zh: 您在4月24日星期一上午10点钟来行吗？

words.en: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
words.zh: 我必须现在就见牙科医生，护士。

words.en: The dentist is very busy at the moment.
Can the dentist see me now?
words.zh: 牙科医生现在就不能给我看一下吗？

words.en: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
words.zh: 恐怕不能，克罗夫特先生。

words.en: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
words.zh: 您就不能等到今天下午吗？

words.en: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
words.zh: 我倒是可以等。可是我的牙痛等不了啊！

words.en: I'm making a shopping list, Tom.
We need a lot of things this week.
words.zh: 这星期我们需要很多东西。

words.en: I must go to the grocer's.
We haven't got much tea or coffee, and we haven't got any sugar or jam.
words.zh: 我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱也没有了。

words.en: I must go to the greengroce's.
words.zh: 我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。

words.en: We haven't got many tomatoes, but we've got a lot of potatoes.
words.zh: 我们番茄不多了，但土豆还有不少。

words.en: I must go to the butcher's, too.
We haven't got any meat at all.
Have we got any beer and wine?
words.zh: 我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

words.en: And I'm not going to get any!
I hope that you've got some money.
Well, I haven't got much either!
Have a glass of whisky then.
We can have dinner at seven o'clock.
Sam and I had lunch together today.
words.zh: 我和萨姆今天一起吃的午饭。

words.en: We had roast beef and potatoes.
words.zh: 我们吃的是烤牛肉和土豆。

words.en: Well, you're going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight!
words.zh: 唉，今晚你们又要吃烤牛肉和土豆了！

words.en: Do you want to have lunch with us?
words.zh: 你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？

words.en: I had lunch at half past twelve.
Have a cup of coffee then.
I've just had a cup, thank you.
I had one after my lunch.
Let's go into the living room, Carol.
words.zh: 我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。

words.en: We can have our coffee there.
words.zh: 我们可以在那里喝咖啡。

words.en: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
words.zh: 萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？

words.en: I've already had my holiday this year.
Have you just been to the cinema?
I saw it on television last year.
words.zh: 我是去年在电视上看的。

words.en: It's an old film, but it's very good.
Have you ever been there, Ken?
It was spring, but the weather was awful.
What's the number of your car?
It's LFZ 312 G. When did you bring it to us?
I brought it here three days ago.

words.zh: 啊，是的，我现在记起来了。
你们的机械师修好了吗？

words.en: No, they're still working on it.
Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.
words.zh: 我们到车库去看一下吧。

words.en: I drove it into a lamp-post.
words.zh: 我把汽车撞在电线杆上了。
你们的机械师能修好吗？

words.en: Well, they're trying to repair it, sir.
words.zh: 啊，他们正设法修呢，先生。

words.en: But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!
words.zh: 不过说实在的，您需要一辆新车了。

words.en: I believe that this house is for sale.
words.zh: 我想这房子是要出售的吧！

words.en: May I have a look at it, please?
How long have you lived here?
words.zh: 您在这里住了多长时间？

words.en: I've lived here for twenty years.

words.zh: 是啊，从1976年起我就住在这里。

words.en: Then why do you want to sell it?
words.zh: 那么，您为什么要卖掉它呢？

words.en: I want to buy a small house in the country.
words.zh: 我想在乡下买幢小房子。

words.en: How much does this house cost?
It's worth every penny of it.
words.zh: 它确确实实值这么多钱。

words.en: Well, I like the house, but I can't decide yet.
words.zh: 啊，我喜欢这房子，但我还不能决定。

words.en: My wife must see it first.
words.zh: 我妻子必须先来看一看。

words.en: Women always have the last word.
words.zh: 女人总是最后说了算的。

words.en: Has Ian sold his house yet?
words.zh: 伊恩已经把他的房子卖掉了吗？

words.en: Has he moved to his new house yet?
He has always been a good neighbour.

words.zh: 我们大家都会想念他的。

words.en: When will the new people move into this house?
words.zh: 新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

words.en: I think that they'll move in the day after tomorrow.
words.zh: 我想他们将会在后天搬进来吧。

words.en: Will you see Ian today, Jenny?
words.zh: 詹尼，您今天会见到伊恩吗？

words.en: He didn't want to leave this house.
words.zh: 他本不想离开这幢房子。

words.en: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
words.zh: 是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开。

words.en: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.
words.zh: 奈杰尔是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。

words.en: He was in the R.A.F. He will fly to New York next month.
words.zh: 他曾在皇家空军任职。下个月他将飞往纽约。

words.en: The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.
words.zh: 再下个月他将飞往东京。

words.en: At the moment, he's in Madrid.
He flew to Spain a week ago.
words.zh: 他是一星期以前飞到西班牙的。

words.en: He'll return to London the week after next.
words.zh: 再下个星期他将返回伦敦。

words.en: He's only forty-one years old, and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
words.zh: 他只有41岁，但他却过世界上几乎每一个国家。

words.en: Nigel is a very lucky man.
words.zh: 奈杰尔是个很幸运的人。

words.en: But his wife isn't very lucky.
words.zh: 但他的妻子运气不很好。

words.en: Two return tickets to London, please.
words.zh: 买两张到伦敦的往返票。

words.en: What time will the next train leave?
words.zh: 下一班火车什么时候开？

words.en: What time will the next train leave?
words.zh: 下一班火车什么时候开？

words.en: It's only three minutes to eight.
Let's go and have a drink.
There's a bar next door to the station.
We had better go back to the station now, Ken.
words.zh: 肯，我们现在最好回车站去。

words.en: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.
words.zh: 我们要乘8点19分的车去伦敦。
你们刚好错过了那班车。

words.en: I left a suitcase on the train to London the other day.
words.zh: 几天前我把一只手提箱忘在开往伦敦的火车上了。
先生，您能描述一下它是什么样子的吗？

words.en: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip.
words.zh: 是只蓝色的小箱子，上面有拉链。

words.en: There's a label on the handle with my name and address on it.
words.zh: 箱把上有一标签，上面写着我的姓名和住址。

words.en: This case doesn't belong to me!
You've given me the wrong case!

words.zh: 我滑了一跤，从楼梯上摔下来了。

words.en: I think that I've hurt my back.
I'm afraid that I can't get up.
I think that the doctor had better see you.
words.zh: 我想最好请医生来给你看一下。
我去给卡特医生打电话。

words.en: The doctor says that he will come at once.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
words.zh: 安迪，我看你需要做一次X光透视。

words.en: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
words.zh: 请把吉米的明信片念给我听听，彭妮。

words.en: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
words.zh: “我刚到苏格兰，我现住在一家青年招待所。”

words.en: He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
words.zh: 他说他住在一家青年招待所。

words.en: You know he's a member of the Y.H.A. The what?
words.zh: 你知道，他是“青招协”的一个成员。什么？

words.en: I hope you are all well.'
I'm afraid I can't hear you.
He says he'll write a letter soon.
He hopes we are all well.
He doesn't say very much, does he?
He can't write very much on a card, Mum.
words.zh: 在明信片上他写不了很多，妈妈。

words.en: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
words.zh: 我想我的英语和数学及格了。

words.en: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.
words.zh: 英语和数学试题对我来说不很容易。

words.en: I think I failed the French paper.
words.zh: 我想我的法语及不了格。

words.en: I could answer sixteen of the questions.
But I couldn't answer the rest.
words.zh: 但我回答不出其余的题。

words.en: They were too difficult for me.
words.zh: 那些题对我来说太难了。

words.en: French tests are awful, aren't they?
I'm sure I've got a low mark.
words.zh: 我的法语成绩肯定很低。

words.en: Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
words.zh: 或许我们考得还不太糟。

words.en: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
words.zh: 坐在我旁边的那个人只在试卷顶端写自己的名字。

words.en: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!
words.zh: 然后他就坐在那里，对着考卷看了3个小时。

words.en: Do you want to speak to her?
I want her to come to my office.
words.zh: 我要她到我的办公室来。

words.en: Tell her to come at once.
Did you want to see me?
You've typed it with only one 'L'.
I want you to type it again.
And here's a little present for you.
words.zh: 这里有一件小礼物送你。
我希望它能对你有所帮助。

words.en: Do you like this dress, madam?
words.zh: 夫人，您喜欢这件衣服吗？

words.en: I like the colour very much.
It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.
words.zh: 这件漂亮的衣服，可是对我来说太小了。

words.en: Short skirts are in fashion now.
Would you like to try it?
I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well.
words.zh: 恐怕这件绿色的我穿着也太小了。

words.en: It's smaller than the blue one.
words.zh: 它比那件蓝色的还要小。

words.en: I don't like the colour either.
It doesn't suit me at all.
words.zh: 这颜色我穿根本不合适。

words.en: I think the blue dress is prettier.
words.zh: 我认为那件蓝色的更漂亮些。

words.en: Could you show me another blue dress?
words.zh: 您能再给我看一件蓝色的吗？

words.en: I want a dress like that one, but it must be my size.
words.zh: 我想一件和那件一样的，但必须是我的尺寸。

words.en: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress.
This is the largest dress in the shop.
Shall I make some coffee, Jane?
One and a half teaspoonfuls, please.
I think there are a few in that box.
words.zh: 我想那个盒子里有一些。

words.en: I like this television very much.
words.zh: 我非常喜欢这台电视机。

words.en: It's the most expensive model in the shop.

words.zh: 这对我们来说是太贵了。

words.en: We can't afford all that money.
This model's less expensive than that one.
words.zh: 这种型号比那种要便宜些。

words.en: But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.
words.zh: 但是，它当然没有价钱高那种好。

words.en: The other model's more expensive, but it's worth the money.
words.zh: 那种型号价格是贵一些，但它值得那么多钱。

words.en: Can we buy it on instalments?
words.zh: 我们可以用分期付款的方式]购买吗？

words.en: You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds, and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
words.zh: 您可以先付30英镑定金，然后每月14镑,3年付清。

words.en: I certainly do, but I don't like the price.
words.zh: 我当然喜欢，但是我不喜欢这个价钱。

words.en: You always want the best, but we can't afford it.
words.zh: 你总是要买最好的，可我们买不起。

words.en: Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!
words.zh: 有时候你认为自己是个百万富翁！

words.en: Millionaires don't buy things on instalments!
words.zh: 百万富翁是不会分期付款买东西的！
请买一张到特拉法加广场的票。

words.en: I can't change a ten-pound note.
Haven't you got any small change?
I've got no small change, I am afraid.
I'll ask some of the passengers.
Have you any small change, sir?
Can you change this ten-pound note, madam?
words.zh: 夫人，您能把这10英镑的钞票换开吗？

words.en: Neither can I. I'm very sorry, sir.
words.zh: 我也不能。非常抱歉，先生。

words.en: You must get off the bus.
None of our passengers can change this note.
words.zh: 我们的乘客中没人能换开这张钞票。

words.en: I'm sure there's no one at home.
Carol and Tom invited us to lunch.
words.zh: 卡罗尔和汤姆请我们来吃午饭。

words.en: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden.
words.zh: 大家都想在花园里吃午饭。

words.en: It's nice and warm out here.
Come and have something to drink.
May I have a glass of beer please?
When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
words.zh: 今天早晨我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在地上了。

words.en: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
words.zh: 我们虽然找了，但没有把它们全部找到。

words.en: While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
words.zh: 正当我们吃早饭时，我们的小男孩汤米在地上找到两枚小硬币。

words.en: He put them both into his mouth.
words.zh: 他把这两枚硬币全都放进嘴里。

words.en: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
words.zh: 我们俩都试图把这两枚硬币拿出来，但太迟了。
汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！

words.en: Late that morning, when I was doing the housework, My husband phoned me from the office.
words.zh: 那天下午的晚些时候，当我正做家务时，我丈夫从办公室打来电话。

words.en: 'I don't know,' I answered, 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
words.zh: “我不知道”，我回答说，“今天上午汤米去了3次厕所了，但我还没看到硬币！”

words.en: I want to tell you a true story.
words.zh: 我要告诉你一个真实的故事。

words.en: It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
words.zh: 这是一年前发生在我的一个朋友身上的故事。

words.en: While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
words.zh: 当我的朋友乔治在床上看书时，两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。

words.en: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room.
words.zh: 他们进到屋里后，走进了饭厅。

words.en: It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
words.zh: 饭厅很暗，于是他们打开了手电筒。

words.en: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them.
words.zh: 突然他们听到身后有声音。

words.en: The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
words.zh: 小偷扔下了手电筒，飞快地逃走了。

words.en: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
words.zh: 乔治听到了响声，迅速地下了楼。

words.en: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone.
words.zh: 他开了灯，但不见一个人。

words.en: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there.
words.zh: 但时乔治的鹦鹉亨利仍在那里。

courses.title: Lesson 121 · The Man in a Hat

words.en: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
words.zh: 半小时以前我在这里买了两本很贵的辞典，但是我忘了拿走。

words.en: The lady who is standing behind the counter.
words.zh: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。

words.en: The books which are on the counter.
Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline?
words.zh: 卡罗琳，半小时前你接待过这位先生吗？

words.en: He says he's the man who bought these books.
words.zh: 他说他就是买这两本书的人。

words.en: The man who I served was wearing a hat.
words.zh: 我接待的那个人戴着一顶帽子。

words.en: Have you got a hat, sir?
Would you put it on, please?
Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
words.zh: 卡罗琳，这就是你接待过的那个人吗？

words.en: This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
words.zh: 这是我到澳大利亚旅行时拍的一张照片。

words.en: They're people I met during the trip.
words.zh: 他们是我旅行时认识的人。

words.en: That's the ship we travelled on.
words.zh: 这是我们所乘的那条船。

words.en: That's the man I told you about.
words.zh: 这就是我跟你说过的那个人。

words.en: The one who offered you a job in Australia.
words.zh: 就是在澳大利亚给你工作的那个人。

words.en: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off when I came home.
words.zh: 我在旅行时留了胡子，但我回到家时就把它刮了。

words.en: Why did you shave it off?
Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?
words.zh: 彼得，你现在能进来喝茶吗？

words.en: I must water the garden first.
Do you have to water it now?
Last summer it was very dry, too.
I had to water it every day.
Well, I'll have tea by myself.
That means you don't need to water the garden.
words.zh: 这就是说，你不必给花园浇水了。

words.en: It means I can have tea, instead.
words.zh: 这意味着我反倒可以喝茶了。

words.en: Can you recognize that woman, Liz?
words.zh: 莉兹，你能认出那个女人吗？

words.en: It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.
words.zh: 那一定是女演员卡伦·马什。
康拉德.里弗斯，那个男演员吗？
他不是她的第3个丈夫吗？

words.en: No. He must be her fourth or fifth.
words.zh: 不，他一定是她的第4个或第5个丈夫。
卡伦·马什看上去多显老啊！

words.en: I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.
words.zh: 我从报上看到她是29岁，但她一定至少有40岁了。

words.en: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
words.zh: 当我还是学生时，她就是个著名的演员了。

words.en: That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
words.zh: 那是好久以前的事了。是吗？

words.en: I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.

words.zh: 那个警察正朝你挥手呢。

words.en: Where do you think you are?
words.zh: 你认为你现在是在哪儿？

words.en: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
words.zh: 你刚才一定是以每小时70英里的速度开车。

words.en: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
words.zh: 我是以每小时80英里的速度赶上你的。

words.en: Didn't you see the speed limit?
words.zh: 难道你没看见限速牌吗？
警官，他思想没有开小差。

words.en: I was telling him to drive slowly.
words.zh: 我刚才正告诉他开慢点。

words.en: That's why I didn't see the sign.
words.zh: 所以我才没看见那牌子。

words.en: Let me see your driving licence.
words.zh: 让我看一看你的驾驶执照。

words.en: I won't charge you this time.
But you'd better not do it again!
words.zh: 但你最好不要再开得这样快。
我以后一定会多加注意。

words.en: I told you to drive slowly, Gary.
words.zh: 加里，我刚才叫你开慢点吧。

words.en: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
words.zh: 你总是叫我开慢点，亲爱的。

words.en: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
words.zh: 好啦，下次你最好还是听从我的劝告！

words.en: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
words.zh: 加里，今年你们打算去哪里度假？

words.en: My wife wants to go to Egypt.
I'd like to go there, too.
We can't make up our minds.
Will you travel by sea or by air?
words.zh: 你们乘船去，还是乘飞机去？

words.en: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
words.zh: 可能是便宜些，但花的时间长。
我肯定你们一定会玩得很痛快。
我们可能哪里也去不成。

words.en: My wife always worries too much.
Who's going to look after the dog?
Who's going to look after the house?
Who's going to look after the garden?
We have this problem every year.
words.zh: 我们每年都碰到这类问题。

words.en: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
words.zh: 末了，我们呆在家里来照看一切。

words.en: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
words.zh: 您刚拍完一部新电影吗，马什小姐？

words.en: Are you going to make another?
I don't want to make another film for a long time.
words.zh: 我早就不想再拍片子了。
由本报记者艾伦.琼斯报导。

words.en: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
words.zh: 卡伦.马什今天到达伦敦机场。

words.en: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
words.zh: 她穿着一身蓝色的套装和一件貂皮大衣。

words.en: She told me she had just made a new film. she said she was not going to make another.
words.zh: 她告诉我她刚拍完一部新片子。她不准备再拍电影了。

words.en: She said she was going to retire.
She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
words.zh: 她告诉记者她感到很疲劳，早就不想再拍电影了。

words.en: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
words.zh: 马什小姐，您真的准备退休吗？

words.en: I can't make up my mind.
I will have to ask my future husband.
words.zh: 我得问一下我的未婚夫。

words.en: He won't let me make another film.
words.zh: 他不会再让我拍电影了。

words.en: Let me introduce him to you.
words.zh: 让我把他给你们介绍一下。

words.en: We're going to get married next week.
words.zh: 下星期我们就要结婚了。

words.en: Here's another report about Karen Marsh.
words.zh: 这又有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。
你听：“卡伦·马什：最新消息。”

words.en: At her London Hotel today Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire.
words.zh: 今天在伦敦旅馆，马什小姐告诉记者她可能要退休。

words.en: She said she couldn't make up her mind.
She said she would have to ask her future husband.
words.zh: 她说她得问问她的未婚夫。

words.en: She said her future husband would not let her make another film.
words.zh: 她说她的未婚夫不会再让她拍电影。

words.en: Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.'
words.zh: 然后她把我们介绍给卡洛斯，并告诉我们说他们下星期结婚。

words.en: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?
words.zh: 凯特，这真是条轰动的消息，是不是？

words.en: Are you doing the football pools, Brain?
words.zh: 布赖恩，你正在下足球赛的赌注吗？
是的，我这就做完了，朱莉。

words.en: I'm sure we'll win something this week.
words.zh: 我敢肯定这星期我们会赢一点的。

words.en: You always say that, but we never win anything!
words.zh: 你老是那样说，但是我们从来没赢过！

words.en: What will you do if you win a lot of money?
words.zh: 要是你赢了许多钱，你打算做什么呢？

words.en: If I win a lot of money I'll buy you a mink coat.
words.zh: 要是我赢了许多钱，我给你买件貂皮大衣。

words.en: I don't want a mink coat!
I want to see the world.
If we win a lot of money we'll travel round the world and we'll stay at the best hotels.
words.zh: 要是我们赢了很多钱，我们就去周游世界，并且往最好的旅馆。

words.en: Then we'll return home and buy a big house in the country.
words.zh: 然后我们返回家园，在乡下买幢大房子。

words.en: We'll have a beautiful garden and...
words.zh: 我们将有一个漂亮的花园和……。

words.en: But if we spend all that money we'll be poor again.
words.zh: 但是如果我们把所有钱都花光了，我们又会变穷的。

words.en: If we spend all the money we'll try and win the football pools again.
words.zh: 如果我们花光了所有钱，我们设法在足球赛赌注上再赢一次。

words.en: It's a pleasant dream but everything depends on 'if' !
words.zh: 这是个美好的梦，但一切都取决于“如果”！

words.en: Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
words.zh: 你告诉玛丽，今晚吃饭将晚到一会儿。
恐怕我还不明白您的意思。

words.en: She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.
words.zh: 她邀请我和夏洛特今晚去吃饭。

words.en: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock, but the boss wants me to do some extra work.
words.zh: 我说过我6点到你家，但老板要我加班。

words.en: I'll have to stay at the office.
I don't know when I'll finish.
words.zh: 不知道什么时候才能结束。

words.en: Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.
words.zh: 喔，顺便问一问，我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮忙。

words.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
words.zh: 我不知道您在说些什么。

words.en: That is John Smith, isn't it?
You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?
words.zh: 你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吗？

words.en: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?
words.zh: 你在海外工程公司上班，是吗？

words.en: I'm John Smith the telephone engineer and I'm repairing your telephone line.
words.zh: 我是电话工程师约翰.史密斯，我正在修理您的电话线。

words.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
words.zh: 上周，我4岁的女儿萨莉被邀请去参加一个儿童聚会。

words.en: I decided to take her by train.
Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
words.zh: 萨莉非常激动，因为她从未乘过火车。

words.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
words.zh: 她靠车窗坐着，对她所看到的一切都要问个明白。

words.en: Suddenly, a middle-age lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
words.zh: 突然，一个中年妇女上了火车，坐在萨莉的对面。

words.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
words.zh: 萨莉没回答，却好奇地看着她。

words.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
words.zh: 那位妇女穿着一件蓝色的大衣，戴着一顶大而滑稽的帽子。

words.en: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
words.zh: 火车开出车站后，那位妇女找开了手提包，拿出了粉盒。

words.en: She then began to make up her face.
'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
words.zh: “为了把自己打扮漂亮啊，”那位妇女答道。

words.en: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
words.zh: 她放好了粉盒，慈祥地微笑着。

words.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
words.zh: 萨莉感到很有趣，而我却很尴尬。

courses.title: Lesson 143 · A Walk Through the Woods

words.en: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
words.zh: 我住在一个由美丽的树林环绕的古老的小镇上。

words.en: It is a famous beauty spot.
words.zh: 这是一个著名的风景胜地。

words.en: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
words.zh: 每适星期天，有许许多人从城里来观赏我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。

words.en: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
words.zh: 游客已被告知要保持树林的整洁。

words.en: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
words.zh: 树下都已设置了废物筐，但是人们仍到处扔垃圾。

words.en: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
words.zh: 上星期三我到树林里去散步。

words.en: What I saw made me very sad.
words.zh: 我所见到的一切使我非常难过。

words.en: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
words.zh: 我数了一下，有7辆旧汽车和3上旧冰箱。

words.en: The little baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
words.zh: 废物筐是空的，而满地都是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎，空瓶子和生锈的空罐头盒。

words.en: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
words.zh: 在垃圾堆中我发现了一块牌子，上面写着：“凡在此树林里丢弃垃圾者，将依法处置。”
